privacy.title: Your privacy comes first
privacy.lead: We only ever share your city and dates, never your location.
points: Layovers show as a city and a date window — never a hotel, street or live position.
You choose who can see you: friends, your airline or all verified crew.
Your phone number and date of birth are never shown to anyone.

guidelines.title: Community & safety guidelines
guidelines.lead: CrewUp works because crew look out for each other.
points: Be yourself: use your real name and photo.
Respect boundaries — no harassment, pressure or unwanted contact.
Keep layover plans in public places until you know someone.
Never share another crew member's roster or location.
Report anything that feels wrong. We review every report.
